subject.title: fix(elevenlabs): add timeout to voices list request

question: Should the speech provider `listVoices` hook accept an optional `timeoutMs` so voice discovery shares configured provider timeouts?
rationale: This is a clean bug fix, but it expands an exported plugin SDK request shape, and automation should not make that API contract decision without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept optional timeout hook
options.body: Treat `timeoutMs?: number` as the supported additive voice-list hook contract and proceed with normal merge gates.

options.title: Keep hook shape unchanged
options.body: Ask for a replacement that bounds ElevenLabs direct voice discovery without adding a new exported hook field.

recommendation.title: Accept optional timeout hook
recommendation.body: Treat `timeoutMs?: number` as the supported additive voice-list hook contract and proceed with normal merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current speech provider and TTS runtime surfaces were introduced in the merged guided onboarding work attributed to this owner.
